title_zh: 京张智脉用户画像与场景-空间-运营映射
title_en: Jing-Zhang AI Spine — Personas and Scenario-Space-Operation Mapping
generated_for: agent.3 AI+场景赋能新范式与智能化AI活力城市设计
summary_zh: 围绕京张智脉（Jing-Zhang AI Spine）识别 6 类核心用户，建立「场景—空间—运营」映射，回应任务书不少于 5 类用户画像的必答要求。
summary_en: Six core persona groups along the Jing-Zhang AI Spine with a scenario–space–operation map, satisfying the taskbook requirement of at least five persona classes.

personas.archetype_zh: 热衷把模型做成产品、需要低门槛算力与社群网络
personas.archetype_en: Wants to turn models into products with low-friction compute and community
needs_zh: 开发者同伴与资本对接
personas.key_area_zh: 众智园 AI 自主创新加速区 / 北京 AI 原点社区
personas.key_area_en: Zhongzhiyuan AI Self-Innovation Acceleration Area / Beijing AI Origin Community
personas.spatial_anchor_zh: 智脉立交·开源算力之芯、开发者驿站
personas.spatial_anchor_en: Spine Interchange · Open-Compute Core; Developer Station
personas.operation_zh: 通过算力预约平台订舱，入驻开发者驿站参与周路演，多语服务屏对接国际导师
personas.operation_en: Books compute via the reservation platform, joins the Developer Station for weekly demos, connects with international mentors via multilingual service screens

personas.archetype_zh: 做可复现实验、需要合规沙箱与联合算力
personas.archetype_en: Runs reproducible experiments needing compliant sandboxes and shared compute
personas.key_area_zh: 众智园 AI 自主创新加速区
personas.spatial_anchor_zh: 安全合规中心、开源算力之芯
personas.operation_zh: 在红队演练中提交模型，使用合规沙箱与联合算力，成果回流开源社区
personas.operation_en: Submits models in red-team drills, uses compliant sandboxes and shared compute, returns output to the open-source community

personas.archetype_zh: 寻找真实场景共建与品牌联动机会
personas.archetype_en: Seeks real-world scenario co-building and brand linkage
personas.key_area_zh: 大钟寺 AI 产业集聚区
personas.spatial_anchor_zh: 钟寺回声·开源钟、智能原生消费组团
personas.spatial_anchor_en: Dazhongsi Echo · Open Bell; smart-native consumption cluster
personas.operation_zh: 以开源钟策展联名，夜间经济组团试运营智能原生业态，贡献案例进入荣誉步道
personas.operation_en: Co-curates with the Open Bell, pilots smart-native formats in the night-economy cluster, and contributes cases to the Honor Promenade

personas.archetype_zh: 要便利、无障碍、有温度的日常城市服务
personas.archetype_en: Wants convenient, accessible, warm everyday urban services
personas.key_area_zh: 北京 AI 原点社区 / 京张遗址公园绿廊
personas.key_area_en: Beijing AI Origin Community / Jing-Zhang Heritage Park Green Corridor
personas.spatial_anchor_zh: 荣誉步道、AI 食堂、慢行主轴
personas.spatial_anchor_en: Honor Promenade; AI Canteen; active-mobility spine
personas.operation_zh: 无障碍伴随 App 规划路线，社区食堂刷脸取餐，慢行导航串联绿廊日常通勤
personas.operation_en: Plans routes with the Accessibility Companion app, picks up meals at the AI canteen, and commutes via active-mobility navigation along the green corridor

personas.name_zh: 城市治理者与安全运维
personas.archetype_zh: 需要可监测、可复核、可应急的城市运行底座
personas.archetype_en: Needs monitorable, reviewable, emergency-ready urban operations
personas.key_area_zh: 全带覆盖（三重点区 + 绿廊）
personas.spatial_anchor_zh: 安全合规中心、能源微网、公共空间组件库
personas.spatial_anchor_en: Safety & Compliance Center; energy micro-grid; public-space component library
personas.operation_zh: 红队演练持续压测，能源与垃圾分类组件接入微网，应急联动在公共空间组件上演练
personas.operation_en: Runs continuous red-team stress tests, links energy and waste components to the micro-grid, and drills emergency coordination on public-space components

personas.archetype_zh: 需要多语导览与可打卡的 AI 朝圣地标
personas.archetype_en: Needs multilingual guidance and visitable AI pilgrimage landmarks
personas.key_area_zh: 京张遗址公园绿廊（之字原点·AI 圣火塔）
personas.key_area_en: Jing-Zhang Heritage Park Green Corridor (Zigzag Origin · AI Flame Tower)
personas.spatial_anchor_zh: 之字原点·AI 圣火塔、多语服务屏
personas.spatial_anchor_en: Zigzag Origin · AI Flame Tower; multilingual service screens
personas.operation_zh: AI 遗址公园导览讲述铁路遗产，多语服务屏切换语言，慢行导航串联朝圣地标
personas.operation_en: The AI Heritage Park Guide narrates railway heritage, multilingual screens switch languages, and active-mobility navigation links the pilgrimage landmarks

mapping_table_zh: 用户画像 → 主场景 → 重点区 → 运营机制：P-01→SC-04/05/12→众智园/原点社区→算力预约+驿站路演；P-02→SC-04/06→众智园→合规沙箱+红队；P-03→SC-07/09→大钟寺→策展联名+夜间试运营；P-04→SC-02/03/08→原点社区/绿廊→无障碍+食堂+慢行；P-05→SC-06/10/11→全带→监测+微网+应急；P-06→SC-01/12/08→绿廊→导览+多语+打卡。
mapping_table_en: Persona → primary scenarios → key area → operation: P-01→SC-04/05/12→Zhongzhiyuan/Origin→compute booking + station demos; P-02→SC-04/06→Zhongzhiyuan→compliant sandbox + red-team; P-03→SC-07/09→Dazhongsi→co-curation + night pilot; P-04→SC-02/03/08→Origin/Corridor→accessibility + canteen + active mobility; P-05→SC-06/10/11→belt-wide→monitoring + micro-grid + emergency; P-06→SC-01/12/08→Corridor→guide + multilingual + check-in.
compliance_note: 所有画像与映射均为概念建议与参考方案，供专业团队深化；不构成政府审定结论，亦不预设任何个人数据采集合规边界之外的监控。
